answer: Each identity must forge a time-lock ticket first: a sequential delay puzzle bound to the epoch seed, needing ten minutes of compute no farm can shortcut. The ticket carries a 15.000 POA bond; a forged ticket or jury-confirmed Sybil forfeits it, half burned and half paid to the reporter, plus an eight-epoch ban. Running 1.000 fakes costs 15.000 × 1.000 = 15.000.000 POA plus 1.000 sequential puzzles, while an honest agent pays once and runs one puzzle. A river of fakes dries when every drop is earned in sequence, yet a meadow of honest agents on slow devices may still miss the window.
